stem: Under last click, brand search gets 45% of Voltmarkt's revenue and social ads get 5%. Many paths start with a social ad and end with a brand search. What is the soundest conclusion?

options.text: Social ads add little to sales, so their budget could be cut without losing any orders
Brand search causes 45% of all sales, so its budget should rise the most
Last click credits only the closer, so social's role in opening paths is hidden
The report must be wrong, since a brand search cannot be the last touch
